 Kelly to host phone Medicare open enrollment town hall 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Nov 17, 2026 
 Updated 
 17 mins ago 
 0 
 U.S. Rep. Mike Kelly
 Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... 
 U.S. Rep. Mike Kelly (R-16) will hold his annual Medicare open enrollment town hall at 6 p.m. Wednesday for 16th Congressional District residents, which include all of Lawrence County.
 Kelly will be joined by officials from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services and the Pennsylvania Medicare Education & Decision Insight.
